_doc: #1783 P5 deterministic versions. versionCode = max(floor, 3,000,000 + minutes since 2026-01-01 UTC of the SOURCE commit time) instead of the wall-clock build minute: the same commit always builds the same code, and a rebuild of unchanged inputs is no new version (the publish gate skips it on the unchanged input identity; the Store compares the sha256 sidecar). `floor` is 3,000,000 + the minutes to 2026-11-18T00:00Z, above every code published before the change, so an installed app is never offered a lower code. BUILD_TIMESTAMP is the source commit time and STACK_GRADLE_CONFIG_MS is 0 (no wall clock in BuildConfig). `pending` are the app gradle files still on the old wall-clock block; the guard (cloud-android-versioncode-guard.py) ratchets it down and the fan-out budget (5 apps per push) sets the batch size: apply with `cloud-android-versioncode-guard.py apply <file>...`. Not covered: the comms forks (matrix, chat, dialer, gallery, mail, termux, nix-on-droid) take COMMS_BUILD_TIMESTAMP from the workflow clock and name timestamped releases with it - an owner decision.
